title: Graham Hancock's text doubting the Giza SAR source

tellings.quote: I texted Graham Hancock about it. He said, "I have no reason to um believe that the source here is being honest."

plain: The writer Graham Hancock, known for his books on lost ancient civilisations, doubts the source behind radar readings said to show hidden features under the Giza plateau. Michels says he texted Hancock about the claims, which rest on SAR, a kind of radar imaging done from satellites, and tied to a researcher named Filippo Biondi, and that Hancock wrote back: "I have no reason to believe that the source here is being honest." Michels shares the text himself in 2025, so it comes as Hancock's private view passed on by the host.
